subject: reasoning
question:
Select the number from among the given options that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series.

14, 12, 27, 25, 53, 51, ?
solution:
**Logic :** Alternate series is followed here i.e

 
• First series → Each number is multiplied (2) and then (1) is added starting with first number.
 
• Second series → Each number is multiplied (2) and then (1) is subtracted starting with second number.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3af2865adefb5892a77438d43c85c5217c4af22a8585c1854f26962e67dfc42c.png] 

Hence, **"105"** is the correct answer.
